items.title: Would you let AI chatbots smear your competitors?
items.summary: Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff, along with his panel of experts, weigh in on ethics and trust concerns surrounding companies' use of AI chatbots to smear competitors. Today's panel includes Paisley Nardini, Chief Investment Strategist at Tema ETFs; David Wagner, Head of Equity and Portfolio Manager at Aptus Capital Advisors; Dan DeFrancesco, Executive Editor and anchor of Business Insider Today; and Barron's reporter Nate Wolf.

items.title: Xcel Energy (XEL) Faces Community Pushback Over 780 MW AI Data Center Plan
items.summary: Xcel Energy (NasdaqGS:XEL) and Google announced the 780 MW Project Skyway data center plan, tying new grid investments to AI computing needs. Local residents and environmental groups are challenging the project over expected water use and ecological impact around the proposed facilities. Regulators and consumer advocates are reviewing proposed customer protection measures that aim to separate data center costs from household bills.
